content: The dissertation's catalogue entry says the R. Shaqq-i Qamar was completed before 18 Rabīʿ I 829/28 January 1426, with an asterisk marking a date that may be transcription rather than composition; the entry also gives the seven-level structure with jurists at the bottom and lettrists sixth, the Imams seventh.
refers_to_primary: R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayan-i Sa'at
